itinerary.description: Return to Aurangabad and visit Bibi Ka Maqbara, a Mughal-era monument often called the Mini Taj Mahal because of its resemblance to the Taj Mahal.

itinerary.description: Continue to Panchakki, a historic water mill known for its traditional engineering system. The site once used flowing water to power a mill and support local needs. It offers a different look at the region's history beyond its famous caves and monuments.

itinerary.description: Drive for around 40 minutes to reach the Ellora Caves, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its remarkable rock-cut temples and monasteries. Your guide will help you understand the history and craftsmanship behind these impressive monuments.

Visit Red Village, known as one of the world's few all-Jewish settlements outside Israel. Juice at Red Village.

Evening: Walk through Nizami Street for shopping and leisure. Soft Drink at Nizami Street.

itinerary.title: Pickup from Your Hotel in Goa
itinerary.description: Your journey begins with an early morning pickup from your hotel in Goa. Settle into your private AC vehicle and enjoy the drive through Karnataka's countryside. Your English-speaking guide will introduce you to Hampi's history and share what you can look forward to during the trip.

itinerary.title: Breakfast Stop Along the Way
itinerary.description: Take a break at a highway restaurant and enjoy a South Indian breakfast. After your meal, get comfortable for the rest of the drive towards Hampi.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hampi & Start of the Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in Hampi, the historic capital of the Vijayanagara Empire and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Get ready to explore its ancient temples, royal structures and remarkable stone monuments with your guide.

itinerary.title: Visit Virupaksha Temple
itinerary.description: Start your Hampi sightseeing at Virupaksha Temple, one of the oldest functioning temples in India. As you explore the temple complex, your guide will share stories about its history, religious importance and place in Hampi's heritage.

itinerary.title: Walk Through Hampi Bazaar & See the Monolithic Bull
itinerary.description: Continue to Hampi Bazaar, a historic market street that once played an important role in the city's commercial life. Walk through the area and take in the remains of its old trading structures. You'll also visit the impressive monolithic Nandi statue, carved from a single block of stone. Take a few photographs before heading to lunch.

itinerary.title: Lunch Break
itinerary.description: Stop at a local restaurant for lunch. You can choose from the available South Indian vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. Note: Lunch is self-paid and not included in the package price.

itinerary.title: Explore Vijaya Vittala Temple & the Stone Chariot
itinerary.description: Visit the famous Vijaya Vittala Temple, one of Hampi's most remarkable historic monuments. Highlights include: The famous Stone Chariot, Musical Pillars, Detailed stone carvings, and Historic temple architecture.

itinerary.title: Royal Enclosure & Queen's Bath
itinerary.description: Step into the royal history of the Vijayanagara Empire as you explore the Royal Enclosure. This area once served as an important centre for royal and administrative activities. Visit historic structures such as the Stepped Tank, King's Audience Hall, Lotus Mahal, and Elephant Stables. As you move through the ruins, you'll get a better sense of the scale and planning of the former royal city.

itinerary.title: Watch the Sunset from Hemakuta Hill
itinerary.description: End your sightseeing day at Hemakuta Hill, a popular viewpoint in Hampi. The hill offers lovely views of ancient temples, granite boulders and the surrounding landscape. Find a comfortable spot, enjoy the changing colours of the sky and capture a few photographs before heading to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Hotel Check-In in Hospet
itinerary.description: After a full day of exploring Hampi, check in to your 3-star hotel in Hospet. Take some time to freshen up and relax for the evening. Overnight Stay: Hospet

itinerary.title: Breakfast at Your Hotel
itinerary.description: Start your morning with breakfast at the hotel. Get ready for the next part of your trip as you prepare to leave for Badami.

itinerary.title: Drive from Hampi to Badami
itinerary.description: Leave Hospet and travel towards Badami in your private AC vehicle. The drive takes approximately 2.5 hours, depending on road and traffic conditions. Enjoy the views of rural Karnataka along the way, with open farmland and rocky hills.

itinerary.title: Explore Badami Cave Temples
itinerary.description: Discover the famous Badami Cave Temples, known for their rock-cut architecture and detailed carvings dating mainly to the 6th and 7th centuries.. Your guide will explain how these caves reflect the art, beliefs and architectural skills of the Chalukya period.

itinerary.title: Agastya Lake & Bhoothanatha Temple
itinerary.description: Continue to Agastya Lake, a peaceful spot surrounded by rocky hills. Take a walk along the lake and enjoy views of the sandstone landscape. Also visit Bhoothanatha Temple near the water and admire its traditional architecture. This is also a good place to take photographs of the temple and its reflection across the lake.

itinerary.title: Lunch Break
itinerary.description: Take a break at a local restaurant and enjoy regional Karnataka cuisine before continuing your sightseeing. Note: Lunch is self-paid and not included in the package price.

itinerary.title: Visit Badami Fort
itinerary.description: Next, head to Badami Fort for views of Agastya Lake, the surrounding red sandstone hills and the historic town below. Explore the remaining fort structures and watchtowers as you learn about Badami's past.

itinerary.title: Begin Your Return Journey to Goa
itinerary.description: After completing your Badami sightseeing, begin the drive back to Goa in your private AC vehicle. Enjoy the changing landscapes along the way, with short rest stops as needed.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa
itinerary.description: Arrive back at your hotel in Goa, bringing your Hampi and Badami tour to an end. It is time to say bye-bye to this beautiful land. Return with stunning photographs and memorable views. Note: Arrival time may vary depending on road conditions, traffic and rest stops.

domestic.title: Cochin Arrival: Visit Fort Kochi

domestic.title: Cochin – Munnar: Visit Waterfalls

domestic.title: Munnar – Thekkady: Visit Spice Plantations

domestic.title: Arrival in Leh: Visit Shanti Stupa
domestic.description: Arrive at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport and transfer to your hotel. Take the day to rest and adjust to Leh's high altitude. In the evening, take a gentle walk through Leh Market if you feel well enough. You can also visit Shanti Stupa to enjoy the sunset views.

domestic.title: Leh Sightseeing: Visit Magnetic Hill
domestic.description: Spend the day visiting Leh's main attractions. See Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace and Phyang Monastery. Continue to Sangam, where the Indus and Zanskar rivers meet. Later, visit Magnetic Hill and Gurudwara Pathar Sahib before returning to Leh.

domestic.title: Leh – Nubra Valley: Cross Khardung La
domestic.description: Drive from Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La, a famous high mountain pass. After reaching Nubra, visit Diskit Monastery and head to the Hunder dunes. You can try a camel ride there at your own cost, subject to availability.

domestic.title: Nubra – Turtuk: Experience Balti Culture
domestic.description: Travel from Nubra Valley to Turtuk, a village near the Line of Control. Learn about the area's Balti culture and local way of life. Then walk through the village and visit its historic mosque and monastery, subject to access and opening hours. Stop at scenic viewpoints along the route.

domestic.title: Nubra – Pangong Lake: Enjoy Lake Views
domestic.description: Drive towards Pangong Lake along the Shyok River route. Enjoy views of the mountains and open valleys during the journey. Pangong Lake is famous for its changing shades of blue and green. Spend the evening by the lake before settling into your overnight stay.

domestic.title: Pangong – Leh: Visit Thiksey Monastery
domestic.description: Leave Pangong Lake and drive back to Leh via Chang La Pass. Enjoy the mountain views along the way. Stop at Thiksey Monastery, known for its large complex and impressive architecture. Then continue to Leh, where you can relax after the day's drive.

domestic.title: Leh Departure: Transfer to Airport
domestic.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out of your hotel. Your driver will transfer you to Leh Airport for your onward journey. Leave Ladakh with memories of its high mountain passes, peaceful monasteries and beautiful lakes.

international.title: Arrival in Leh: Market and Shanti Stupa
international.description: Your guide will meet you at Leh Airport and take you to your hotel. Since Leh is at a high altitude, keep your first day light to give your body time to adjust. In the evening, take a walk through Leh Market and watch the sunset from Shanti Stupa.

international.title: Leh Sightseeing: Monasteries and Landmarks
international.description: Wake up with fresh energy and visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace and Phyang Monastery with your guide. Your guide will share local stories and explain the region's cultural and religious traditions.

international.title: Leh to Nubra Valley: Cross Khardung La
international.description: Drive from Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La, one of the high mountain passes in Ladakh. Your permits will be arranged in advance. international.description: Spend the day visiting villages across Nubra Valley with your guide. Meet local artisans, see traditional crafts and learn about life in this mountain region. You will also have time to enjoy the valley's mountain views before continuing your journey the next day.

international.description: Drive towards Pangong Lake along the Shyok River route. international.description: Leave Pangong Lake and drive back to Leh via Chang La Pass. Stop at Thiksey Monastery along the way to see its traditional architecture and learn about Buddhist practices. international.description: After breakfast, spend some time shopping in Leh for pashmina shawls, dried apricots and local handicrafts. Your guide will then take you to Leh Airport for your onward journey.

domestic.title: Amritsar Sightseeing: Visit Golden Temple
domestic.description: Start your day at the Golden Temple, known for its peaceful setting and beautiful architecture. Next, visit Jallianwala Bagh to learn about an important event in India’s history. In the evening, head to the Wagah Border to watch the flag-lowering ceremony.

domestic.title: Amritsar – Delhi: Train Journey
domestic.description: Board your train from Amritsar to Delhi. The journey usually takes around six to seven hours, depending on the train. After reaching Delhi, transfer to your hotel, check in and spend the rest of the evening relaxing.

domestic.title: Delhi Sightseeing: Visit Red Fort
domestic.description: Begin your city tour in Old Delhi with a visit to the Red Fort and a walk through Chandni Chowk’s busy lanes. Later, see India Gate and the Rashtrapati Bhavan area. Visit Qutub Minar before ending the day with dinner at a local restaurant.

domestic.title: Delhi – Agra: Visit Taj Mahal
domestic.description: Leave Delhi early for the drive to Agra, which usually takes around three to four hours, depending on traffic. Visit the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort to learn about their Mughal history and architecture. After sightseeing, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay in Agra.

domestic.title: Agra – Jaipur: Visit Fatehpur Sikri
domestic.description: Drive to Fatehpur Sikri, around an hour from Agra, depending on traffic. Walk through this historic city and see its important buildings. Continue to Jaipur, a journey of around four to five hours, and check in at your hotel upon arrival.

domestic.title: Jaipur Sightseeing: Visit Amber Fort
domestic.description: Start your Jaipur tour at Amber Fort. You may choose a jeep ride to reach the fort entrance, subject to availability and local rules. Continue to City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Later, see Hawa Mahal from the outside and spend time shopping in Jaipur’s local bazaars.

domestic.title: Jaipur – Ranthambore: Resort Stay
domestic.description: Travel from Jaipur to Ranthambore, a drive of around three to four hours. On arrival, check in at your resort and enjoy some time to rest. Keep the evening relaxed and prepare for the next day’s wildlife safari.

domestic.title: Ranthambore Safari: Spot Wild Tigers
domestic.description: Head out for a morning jeep safari in Ranthambore National Park. Look for Bengal tigers and other wildlife in their natural surroundings. Sightings are never guaranteed, as animals move freely through the forest. Return to your resort for breakfast or lunch and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

domestic.title: Ranthambore – Delhi: Departure
domestic.description: After breakfast, check out of your resort and begin your onward journey towards Delhi. Your transfer can be planned around your flight or train schedule. Allow enough travel time, as the road journey from Ranthambore to Delhi can take several hours.

international.title: Arrival in Amritsar: Local Market Walk
international.description: Your guide will meet you in Amritsar and take you to your hotel. After check-in, spend the evening walking through the local markets with your guide. Browse shops selling traditional clothes, handicrafts and local products before returning to your hotel for the night.

international.title: Amritsar Sightseeing: Golden Temple and Wagah Border
international.description: Visit the Golden Temple in the morning and learn about its history and Sikh traditions from your guide. Continue to Jallianwala Bagh, a memorial that holds an important place in India's history. In the evening, head to Wagah Border to watch the Flag Retreat Ceremony, known for its energetic performances by Indian and Pakistani border guards.

international.title: Amritsar to Delhi: Train Journey
international.description: Travel to Delhi by train, with the journey taking around 6–7 hours, depending on the service. Your guide will help with tickets and finding your platform. Enjoy the countryside views along the way. After reaching Delhi, transfer to your hotel, check in and prepare for the next day's sightseeing.

international.title: Delhi Sightseeing: Old and New Delhi
international.description: Start with a guided walk through Old Delhi, including a visit to the Red Fort and a food walk through the busy lanes of Chandni Chowk. Sample local dishes if you wish, with food costs as per your package arrangements. In the afternoon, visit India Gate, see the Rashtrapati Bhavan area from the permitted viewing points, and continue to Qutub Minar.

international.title: Delhi to Agra: Taj Mahal Visit
international.description: Our team will drive you to Agra from Delhi, a journey of around 3–4 hours, depending on traffic. Visit the Taj Mahal, famous for its white marble and Mughal design. Continue to Agra Fort, where your guide will explain its history and links to the Mughal emperors. Check in to your hotel in Agra for the night.

international.title: Agra to Jaipur: Fatehpur Sikri Stop
international.description: Leave Agra and stop at Fatehpur Sikri, a historic Mughal city and UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk through its courtyards, gateways and palace buildings before continuing to Jaipur. The drive from Fatehpur Sikri to Jaipur takes around 4–5 hours, depending on traffic. Check in to your hotel on arrival.

international.title: Jaipur Sightseeing: Forts and Palaces
international.description: Visit Amber Fort and travel up to the fort by jeep. Continue to City Palace to see its royal courtyards and museum collections, followed by Jantar Mantar, known for its historic astronomical instruments. Stop for photos outside Hawa Mahal and spend some time browsing Jaipur's local bazaars for textiles, jewellery and handicrafts.

international.title: Jaipur to Ranthambore: Resort Stay
international.description: You will be driven from Jaipur to Ranthambore, a journey of around 3–4 hours. Upon arrival, check in to your resort and prepare for your wildlife safari the next day. In the evening, attend a briefing about the park, safari rules and the animals you may see during your visit.

international.title: Ranthambore National Park: Tiger Safaris
international.description: Head out early for your morning jeep safari through Ranthambore National Park. Look for Bengal tigers, deer, crocodiles and birdlife, although sightings cannot be guaranteed. Return to your resort for a break before heading out on a second safari in the evening, subject to your confirmed booking.

international.title: Ranthambore Departure: Transfer to Delhi
international.description: After breakfast, check out of your resort and begin your journey towards Delhi. Plan your departure around your onward flight, allowing enough time for the long road transfer and possible traffic delays. Your guide will assist with the final transfer arrangements.

itinerary.title: Departure from Goa

itinerary.title: Explore Yana Rock Formations
itinerary.description: Visit Yana, a beautiful natural spot known for its huge black rock formations and forest surroundings. Take a walk around the area and admire these unusual rock structures. Enjoy the fresh air, explore the natural scenery and capture some photographs before continuing your journey.

itinerary.title: Hotel Check-In in Shimoga

itinerary.title: Dinner at the Hotel

itinerary.title: Wake Up to Shimoga's Natural Beauty

itinerary.title: Breakfast at Your Hotel

itinerary.title: Forest Safari in Shimoga
itinerary.description: You can experience the forest landscape of the Shimoga region on a safari or forest drive, depending on local availability. itinerary.title: Visit Aghoreshwara Temple at Ikkeri

itinerary.title: Explore Jog Falls

Take your time at the viewpoints and capture photographs of this impressive natural sight. The view may change with the season and water flow.

itinerary.title: Begin Your Return Journey to Goa

domestic.title: Bagdogra – Gangtok: Scenic Mountain Drive
domestic.description: Let's start your trip with a pickup from Bagdogra Airport. Enjoy a comfortable and scenic drive of around five hours to Gangtok, surrounded by green hills and mountain views. domestic.title: Gangtok – Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir
domestic.description: Start the day visiting Tsomgo Lake, a glacial lake located at around 12,400 feet. The lake looks beautiful in different weather conditions, with mountains adding to the view. On your return journey, you will be visiting Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir, a shrine known for its story and local beliefs.

domestic.title: Gangtok – Nathula Pass: Border Visit
domestic.description: Then head to Nathula Pass, located at around 14,140 feet near the Indo-China border. The high mountain setting and views make this a memorable part of your trip. Your special permit is planned for the visit, subject to local rules, weather and road conditions.

domestic.title: Gangtok – Pelling: Visit Namchi
domestic.description: Travel from Gangtok to Pelling via Namchi. Stop at Siddheshwar Dham, also known as the Char Dham complex, to see its religious sites and large temple structures. Continue your drive to Pelling and check in at your hotel by evening. Rest, enjoy and wait for tomorrow's new excitement.

domestic.title: Pelling Sightseeing: Visit Sacred Sites
domestic.description: Begin the day at Khecheopalri Lake, a sacred lake surrounded by forest and hills. Continue to Pemayangtse Monastery, one of Sikkim’s oldest monasteries. Later, visit the Rabdentse Ruins, the remains of an old Sikkimese capital set among greenery. In the evening, rest at your hotel.

domestic.title: Pelling – Darjeeling: Waterfall Views
domestic.description: Wake up with new energy! Exciting drive from Pelling to Darjeeling, stopping at Rimbi Waterfalls along the way. You’ll also visit the Kanchenjunga Viewpoint for photos if the weather offers clear views. Continue to Darjeeling and check in at your hotel by evening.

domestic.title: Darjeeling – Bagdogra: Departure Day

international.title: Bagdogra to Gangtok: Mountain Drive

international.title: Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir Visit
international.description: Drive to Tsomgo Lake, a glacial lake located at around 12,400 feet above sea level. Its appearance changes with the light and weather. international.title: Rumtek Monastery and Silk Route

itinerary.title: Departure from South Goa
itinerary.description: You will start early from South Goa in a private vehicle. Meanwhile, enjoy the road trip towards Hospete and Hampi.

itinerary.title: Hotel Check-in in Hospete
itinerary.description: After reaching Hospete, check in to your 3-star hotel. You can freshen up before heading out for sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Explore the Royal Enclosure
itinerary.description: Visit the Royal Enclosure, which once served as an important centre of the Vijayanagara Empire. See the Mahanavami Dibba, stepped tank, ancient water channels and other royal structures.

itinerary.title: Hazara Rama Temple
itinerary.description: Explore Hazara Rama Temple, known for its detailed stone carvings. Many of these carvings show scenes from the Ramayana.

itinerary.title: Elephant Stables
itinerary.description: Visit the Elephant Stables, a large historic building once used to house royal elephants.

itinerary.title: Lotus Mahal
itinerary.description: Explore Lotus Mahal and admire its unique design. The building blends Hindu and Indo-Islamic architectural styles.

itinerary.title: Vijaya Vittala Temple and Stone Chariot
itinerary.description: Visit the famous Vijaya Vittala Temple complex. See the Stone Chariot and the temple’s detailed stonework. Your guide will explain the history of this famous site.

itinerary.title: Krishna Temple
itinerary.description: Visit the Krishna Temple, built during the reign of Krishnadevaraya. The temple was dedicated to Lord Krishna.

itinerary.title: Queens Bath
itinerary.description: Explore Queen’s Bath, a royal bathing complex known for its design and arches.

itinerary.title: Ugra Narasimha and Badavilinga Temple
itinerary.description: See the large Ugra Narasimha statue carved from a single block of stone. Then visit Badavilinga Temple, home to a huge stone Shiva Lingam.

itinerary.title: Kadalekalu and Sasivekalu Ganesha
itinerary.description: Visit the two famous Ganesha statues. Both are carved from single blocks of stone.

itinerary.title: Virupaksha Temple
itinerary.description: Visit Virupaksha Temple, one of Hampi’s oldest active temples. It is dedicated to Lord Shiva and remains an important place of worship.

itinerary.title: Hemakuta Hill
itinerary.description: End the day at Hemakuta Hill. Enjoy wide views of Hampi’s temples, rocky hills and ancient ruins as the sun sets.

itinerary.title: Return to the Hotel
itinerary.description: Return to your hotel in Hospete and relax after a full day of sightseeing. Stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Sanapur Lake and Return to Goa
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and check out. Get ready to explore more of the Hampi area.

itinerary.title: Sanapur Lake and Coracle Ride
itinerary.description: Visit Sanapur Lake, known for its rocky surroundings and open views. You can enjoy a traditional coracle ride if weather and local conditions allow it. Extra charges may apply, so confirm this before booking.

itinerary.title: More Time at Vijaya Vittala Temple
itinerary.description: Spend more time exploring the Vijaya Vittala Temple complex, including its famous Stone Chariot and detailed carvings. Your guide can share more stories about the site.

itinerary.title: Lunch and Departure for Goa
itinerary.description: Have lunch before starting your return journey to Goa. Enjoy the drive through Karnataka and Goa.

itinerary.title: Arrival in South Goa
itinerary.description: Reach South Goa after the road trip. Your arrival time may change due to traffic and road conditions. Your beautiful trip ends here!
